correctness.rationale: A maximal periodic factor of least period p containing a one has a primitive p-block containing exactly one 1, forcing one-containing run periods among distances b+1 and c+1. Pairwise flank conditions yield one mandatory run plus an extra exactly if b>c,a>=b-c or c>b,d>=c-b; each zero gap length>=2 gives one unary run. This establishes R=1+sum[gap>=2]+two disjoint indicators and max six, attained first at length12. Splitting b=c and b!=c yields bivariate rational GF; six-run GF 2z^12(1+z-z^2)/((1-z)^2(1-z^2)^2) has coefficient asymptotic half of binom(n,3), and all exceptional words O(n^2), hence the 1/2-1/2 five/six limit. Independent direct periodic-interval enumeration for every weight-three word through n=18 agreed.
